reg_deadline.en: You can register at your polling place on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, and vote the same day. Your town or city clerk also takes registrations until 6 to 13 days before the election; the date varies, so ask your clerk. Bring proof of your identity, age, U.S. citizenship and domicile.
reg_deadline.es: Puedes registrarte en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, el martes 3 de noviembre, y votar ese mismo día. El secretario de tu municipio o ciudad (town or city clerk) también acepta registros hasta 6 a 13 días antes de la elección; la fecha cambia, así que pregúntale. Lleva comprobantes de tu identidad, edad, ciudadanía estadounidense y domicilio.
reg_deadline.quote: You can register to vote up to 6-13 days before the election with your local town/city clerk or at a local supervisors of the checklist meeting. ... If you miss the deadline to register before the election, you can register at your polling location on election day. ... You will also need to provide proof of your identity, age, U.S. citizenship and domicile (primary residence address).

mail_request.en: If you qualify to vote absentee, your clerk must receive a mailed application by noon on Monday, November 2. In person at the clerk's office, you can request and return a ballot until 5 p.m. that day. Include the proof of identity the form asks for.
mail_request.es: Si puedes votar en ausencia, el secretario debe recibir tu solicitud por correo a más tardar al mediodía del lunes 2 de noviembre. En persona, en la oficina del secretario, puedes pedir y entregar tu boleta hasta las 5 p. m. de ese día. Incluye el comprobante de identidad que pide el formulario.
mail_request.quote: The deadline to request an absentee ballot by mail is 12:00 p.m. the day before the election. The deadline to request and return an absentee ballot in person is 5:00 p.m. the day before the election.
mail_request.en_after: Absentee ballot requests closed November 2. Vote at your polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de boleta de voto en ausencia cerraron el 2 de noviembre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Returning it yourself? Get it to your town or city clerk by 5 p.m. on Monday, November 2. Ballots sent by mail or brought by a delivery agent, such as a close family member with a signed form and photo ID, must arrive by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. A postmark isn't enough.
mail_return.es: ¿La entregas tú? Llévala al secretario de tu municipio o ciudad (town or city clerk) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre. Las boletas por correo o las que entrega un agente, como un familiar cercano con un formulario firmado e identificación con foto, deben llegar a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no basta.
mail_return.quote: The deadline to request and return an absentee ballot in person is 5:00 p.m. the day before the election. Absentee ballots delivered through the mail or by the voter's delivery agent shall be received by the town, city, or ward clerk no later than 5:00 p.m. on the day of the election.
mail_return.en_after: Ballots sent by mail or brought by a delivery agent, such as a close family member with a signed form and photo ID, must reach your town or city clerk by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. A postmark isn't enough.
mail_return.es_after: Las boletas por correo o las que entrega un agente, como un familiar cercano con un formulario firmado e identificación con foto, deben llegar al secretario de tu municipio o ciudad (town or city clerk) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no basta.

early_hours.notes: New Hampshire has no early voting (states.js kind 'none').

in_person.en: Vote at your town or city polling place on Election Day. If you'll be away, can't get there during polling hours because of work or caring for someone, have a disability, or can't appear in public because of a religious commitment, you can vote absentee instead.
in_person.es: Vota en el lugar de votación de tu municipio o ciudad el Día de las Elecciones. Si vas a estar fuera, no puedes llegar durante el horario de votación por el trabajo o por cuidar a alguien, tienes una discapacidad, o no puedes salir en público por un compromiso religioso, puedes votar en ausencia.
in_person.quote: A person who is unable to appear at any time during polling hours at his or her polling place because of an employment obligation shall be considered absent for purposes of this chapter.

first_time.en: Registering for the first time? No citizenship papers? You can sign a qualified voter affidavit swearing you're a U.S. citizen. Student IDs can't be used to prove who you are when you register, vote absentee or check in, after an October 22 U.S. Supreme Court order.
first_time.es: ¿Te registras por primera vez? ¿No tienes documentos de ciudadanía? Puedes firmar una declaración jurada (qualified voter affidavit) de que eres ciudadano de EE. UU. Las identificaciones de estudiante no sirven para probar quién eres al registrarte, votar en ausencia o presentarte a votar, por una orden de la Corte Suprema de EE. UU. del 22 de octubre.
first_time.quote: Your citizenship may also be proven by completing a qualified voter affidavit attesting, subject to the penalties for voter fraud, that you are a United States citizen but do not possess some or all of the documents necessary to prove your citizenship. ... Note: effective October 22, 2026, registrants cannot use student identification cards to prove identity.

rule.en: Vote at the polling place for your town or ward. The Secretary of State's Voter Information Lookup shows where it is, and your clerk's contact information and hours.
rule.es: Vota en el lugar de votación de tu municipio o distrito (ward). El buscador oficial de la Secretaría de Estado (Voter Information Lookup) te muestra dónde está, y los datos de contacto y el horario del secretario de tu municipio.
rule.quote: You can find your clerk’s contact information and hours using the Secretary of State’s Voter Information Lookup.

locator_label.en: Voter Information Lookup (New Hampshire Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Buscador oficial de información para votantes (Secretaría de Estado de New Hampshire)

en: Driver's license from any state or the federal government
New Hampshire ID card, or a non-driver ID card from another state
es: Licencia de conducir de cualquier estado o del gobierno federal
Tarjeta de identificación de New Hampshire, o tarjeta de identificación para no conductores de otro estado
Tarjeta de identificación de las fuerzas armadas de EE. UU.
Pasaporte o tarjeta pasaporte de EE. UU.
accepted.quote: Only the following forms of identification bearing a photograph of the voter shall satisfy the identification requirements of paragraph I:

expired.en: Your ID can be expired up to five years. If you're 65 or older, the expiration date doesn't matter.
expired.es: Tu identificación puede tener hasta cinco años de vencida. Si tienes 65 años o más, la fecha de vencimiento no importa.
expired.quote: The photo identification shall also have an expiration date that has not been exceeded by a period of more than 5 years, except that a voter 65 years of age or older may use an otherwise qualified form of identification without regard to expiration date.

without.en: No photo ID? You'll see the supervisor of the checklist, who decides whether your identity can be verified. A moderator, clerk, supervisor or selectman who knows you personally can vouch for you. If your identity isn't established, you can't vote, but you can appeal right away to the superior court.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación con foto? Te mandarán con el supervisor del padrón (supervisor of the checklist), que decide si se puede verificar tu identidad. Un moderador, secretario, supervisor o concejal (moderator, clerk, supervisor o selectman) que te conozca personalmente puede responder por ti. Si no se establece tu identidad, no puedes votar, pero puedes apelar de inmediato ante el tribunal superior (superior court).
without.quote: A moderator, clerk, supervisor, or selectman may verify a voter's identity if such moderator, clerk, supervisor, or selectman personally knows the voter.

who.en: You can vote absentee in New Hampshire if you:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia en New Hampshire si:
who.quote: Any person who will be absent on the day of any state election from the city, town, or unincorporated place in which he or she is registered to vote or who cannot appear in public on any election day because of his or her observance of a religious commitment or who is unable to vote there in person by reason of physical disability may vote at such elections as provided in this chapter.

en: will be away from your town or city on Election Day
can't get to your polling place at any time during polling hours because of work, including caring for children or infirm adults
can't appear in public on Election Day because of a religious commitment
can't vote in person because of a physical disability
es: vas a estar fuera de tu municipio o ciudad el Día de las Elecciones
no puedes llegar a tu lugar de votación en ningún momento del horario de votación por el trabajo, incluido el cuidado de niños o adultos enfermos
no puedes salir en público el Día de las Elecciones por un compromiso religioso
no puedes votar en persona por una discapacidad física
who_list.quote: For the purposes of this section, the term "employment" shall include the care of children and infirm adults, with or without compensation.

witness.en: Seal your ballot in the inner envelope and sign the affidavit on it. If someone helps you because you're blind or have a disability, that person signs a statement on the envelope too.
witness.es: Cierra tu boleta en el sobre interior y firma la declaración jurada (affidavit) que viene en él. Si alguien te ayuda porque eres ciego o tienes una discapacidad, esa persona también firma una declaración en el sobre.
witness.quote: The voter shall execute the affidavit on the envelope.

dropbox.notes: RSA 657:17 lists mail, personal delivery and a delivery agent (close family, or nursing or residential care staff); no drop boxes are mentioned. Not stated as 'no drop boxes' because the SOS page was unreadable.

gear.en: No campaigning inside the polling place building. The moderator also sets up a no-electioneering corridor at least 10 feet wide outside each entrance, where posting or handing out signs, pins, stickers or campaign clothing is banned.
gear.es: No se permite hacer campaña dentro del edificio del lugar de votación. El moderador también marca un pasillo sin propaganda electoral de al menos 10 pies de ancho afuera de cada entrada, donde está prohibido poner o repartir letreros, pines, stickers o ropa de campaña.
gear.quote: The distribution or posting of electioneering communications, including but not limited to posters, cards, handbills, placards, pictures, pins, stickers, circulars, or articles of clothing, is prohibited within any no-electioneering corridor established outside the polling place by the moderator.

phone.en: You can photograph your own marked ballot and share it. A federal appeals court struck down New Hampshire's ban in 2016, though the old wording is still in RSA 659:35. Inside the voting area, state law bars any photo that captures another voter or their ballot.
phone.es: Puedes tomarle una foto a tu propia boleta marcada y compartirla. Una corte federal de apelaciones anuló la prohibición de New Hampshire en 2016, aunque el texto viejo sigue en la ley RSA 659:35. Dentro del área de votación, la ley estatal prohíbe cualquier foto que muestre a otro votante o su boleta.
phone.quote: In 2014, New Hampshire amended a statute meant to avoid vote buying and voter intimidation by newly forbidding citizens from photographing their marked ballots and publicizing such photographs. ... We affirm on the narrower ground that the statute as amended fails to meet the test for intermediate scrutiny under the First Amendment and that the statute's purposes cannot justify the restrictions it imposes on speech.

line.en: If you're in line when the polls close, including the line to register, stay in it. You can still register and vote.
line.es: Si estás en la fila cuando cierran las casillas, incluida la fila para registrarte, no te salgas. Todavía puedes registrarte y votar.
line.quote: At the time set for closing the polls to voting, if a line of voters waiting to check in or of people seeking to register to vote and then vote exists, all people who join that line by the moment when the polls close to voting and all who are in line shall be permitted to apply for registration and, if registered, to vote.

tradition.en: New Hampshire's 2026 I Voted stickers were drawn by six fourth- and fifth-grade students from Milford, Windham, Lebanon, Chester, Etna and Nottingham. More than 2,800 students entered the Secretary of State's contest. The winners were announced November 13, 2025, and the designs are handed out statewide during the 2026 state elections.
tradition.es: Los stickers "I Voted" de New Hampshire para 2026 los dibujaron seis estudiantes de cuarto y quinto grado de Milford, Windham, Lebanon, Chester, Etna y Nottingham. Más de 2,800 estudiantes participaron en el concurso de la Secretaría de Estado. Los ganadores se anunciaron el 13 de noviembre de 2025, y los diseños se reparten en todo el estado durante las elecciones estatales de 2026.
tradition.quote: New Hampshire Secretary of State David Scanlan and Deputy Secretary of State Erin Hennessey are excited to announce the six winners of the 2025 “I Voted” Sticker Contest. The winning designs will be distributed statewide during the 2026 state elections. ... Over 2,800 fourth- and fifth-grade students participated in the contest, making it nearly impossible to choose just four winners, so the Secretary of State’s Office chose two additional winners.

line.en: You can still vote. Everyone in line when the polls close, including the line to register, gets to register if needed and vote.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que esté en la fila cuando cierran las casillas, incluida la fila para registrarse, puede registrarse si hace falta y votar.
line.quote: At the time set for closing the polls to voting, if a line of voters waiting to check in or of people seeking to register to vote and then vote exists, all people who join that line by the moment when the polls close to voting and all who are in line shall be permitted to apply for registration and, if registered, to vote.

track.en: Use the Secretary of State's Voter Information Lookup. It shows when your clerk got your request, when your ballot was sent and when your clerk received it back.
track.es: Usa el buscador oficial de la Secretaría de Estado (Voter Information Lookup). Te muestra cuándo recibió tu solicitud el secretario, cuándo te mandaron la boleta y cuándo la recibió de vuelta.
track.quote: After you have applied for an absentee ballot, you can use the Voter Information Lookup to find out if your clerk has received your request, when the absentee ballot was sent to you, and when your clerk received your completed absentee ballot.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on gc.nh.gov (RSA 654:7-a, 654:8, 654:12, 657:1, 657:4, 657:17, 657:22, 659:4, 659:13, 659:35, 659:43, 659:45-a). sos.nh.gov and app.sos.nh.gov return 403 to curl and WebFetch, and Claude in Chrome reports 'Permission denied for reading page content on this domain', so nothing on the SOS site was read: locator URL, ballot tracker, absentee request deadline, drop boxes and the sticker contest are left missing. Selfie kept out on purpose. The ID text uses the version of RSA 659:13 I(c) effective September 8, 2026 (personal-knowledge attestation). Registration before Election Day closes at the supervisors' last session, set by each town (RSA 654:8 II); the FAQ already says so, so reg_deadline leads with Election Day registration.

hours.en: Your town or city sets the hours: polls open by 11 a.m. and close no earlier than 7 p.m.
hours.es: Tu pueblo o ciudad fija el horario: se abre a más tardar a las 11 a. m. y se cierra no antes de las 7 p. m.
hours.quote: At all state elections in towns and cities the polls shall open not later than 11 o'clock in the morning and shall close not earlier than 7 o'clock in the evening. In cities, the city council shall determine the polling hours no later than 30 days prior to a state election.
